summary: Production-ready for HTTP/REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, OTLP tracing, rate limiting, geo-index hooks, and versioned routing as of v1.8.0. Fifteen open items identified: gRPC stub wiring (6), gRPC server correctness (3), GraphQL completeness (2), middleware improvements (4).

findings.claim_source: src/api/ROADMAP.md: Phase 3 [x] gRPC surface with proto definitions
findings.expected: ExecuteAQL RPC executes AQL queries and returns results
findings.observed: themisdb_grpc_service.cpp:~line 302 returns UNIMPLEMENTED with message 'AQL execution requires an AQLEngine; wire one in via ThemisDBGrpcServiceFactory'
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Wire gRPC ExecuteAQL stub via ThemisDBGrpcServiceFactory

findings.expected: Server-side streaming RPC StreamAQL(AQLQueryRequest) returns (stream AQLRow)
findings.observed: themisdb_grpc_service.cpp:~line 337 — streaming loop exists as commented code; returns UNIMPLEMENTED
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Wire gRPC StreamAQL server-side streaming stub

findings.expected: VectorSearch, FilteredVectorSearch, HybridSearch, FullTextSearch RPCs return results
findings.observed: All four handlers return UNIMPLEMENTED in themisdb_grpc_service.cpp:~line 354-393
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Wire gRPC VectorSearch / HybridSearch / FullTextSearch stubs

findings.expected: All writes in BatchWrite RPC succeed or fail atomically
findings.observed: BatchWrite loop calls db_->put() individually; on partial failure, response still returns success=true with no error code
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Fix gRPC BatchWrite partial-failure silent success

findings.expected: GrpcApiServer::start() releases mutex before blocking I/O
findings.observed: grpc_server.cpp:start() calls builder.BuildAndStart() inside std::lock_guard<std::mutex>, blocking stop() and isRunning() for entire port-bind and TLS-handshake duration
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Fix GrpcApiServer::start() holding mutex across BuildAndStart()

findings.expected: GrpcApiServer::stop() completes within a bounded time window
findings.observed: grpc_server.cpp:stop() calls server_->Shutdown() with no deadline — can block indefinitely

findings.claim_source: include/api/graphql.h: documented as Not yet supported
findings.expected: Full GraphQL spec compliance including fragments, directives, inline fragments
findings.observed: graphql.h explicitly documents 'Not yet supported: Fragments, Directives, Inline fragments'; Apollo/Relay-style queries fail at parse time
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Implement GraphQL fragment and directive support in Parser

findings.expected: Schema::introspect() supports __typename, __Field, __InputValue, __EnumValue, __Directive per GraphQL June 2018 spec
findings.observed: Only __schema and __type are handled; introspection-based tooling does not work fully
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Add missing GraphQL introspection meta-types (__typename, __Field, etc.)

findings.expected: RateLimiter::buckets_ map does not grow unbounded in long-running deployments
findings.observed: Every unique key creates a Bucket entry that is never evicted; stale tenant-ID/IP entries accumulate indefinitely
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Add TTL-based stale bucket eviction to RateLimiter

findings.expected: AuditLogger::log() does not hold mutex during handler callbacks
findings.observed: audit_logger.h::log() holds std::lock_guard for entire body including handler dispatch loop; file-writing/network handlers stall all concurrent API threads
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Fix AuditLogger blocking handler dispatch under mutex

findings.expected: invalidatePattern(collection) evicts only entries referencing the given collection
findings.observed: graphql_cache.h:290 ignores the pattern argument and calls cache_.clear()
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Implement selective collection-based cache invalidation in ResponseCache

findings.expected: OtlpExporter reuses a persistent CURL* handle across flush batches
findings.observed: otlp_exporter.cpp::flushBatch() calls curl_easy_init()/curl_easy_cleanup() on every flush
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Use persistent CURL handle in OtlpExporter::flushBatch()

findings.expected: WsChangeHandler::validate() URL-decodes from_sequence and key_prefix query-string parameters
findings.observed: ws_handler.cpp uses std::string::find for ad-hoc parsing; percent-encoded values are never decoded
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Fix WsChangeHandler URL-decoding for query-string parameters

findings.expected: A concrete GrpcBridgeImpl class registers services and routes dispatches
findings.observed: grpc_bridge.h defines pure-virtual IGRPCBridge; no concrete implementation exists
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Implement GrpcBridgeImpl concrete class for IGRPCBridge interface

findings.expected: QueryAllowList enforcement active in production builds; startup warning if disabled
findings.observed: persisted_queries.h::QueryAllowList has enabled_=false in default constructor; no startup THEMIS_WARN emitted in NDEBUG builds
findings.issue_title_suggestion: [api] Add startup warning when QueryAllowList is disabled in production
